description: Defines the EmailAction class for sending emails within Drupal, including dependency injection, configuration, validation, and execution logic.

classes.name: EmailAction
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for sending emails, implementing configuration, validation, and execution logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies such as token service, entity storage, logger, mail, language, and email validator.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class using the service container.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the email sending operation based on configuration and recipient data.

methods.description: Provides default configuration values for recipient, subject, and message.

methods.name: validateConfigurationForm
